# ThermoSlop

> Unofficial local HomeKit control for ecobee thermostats: a CLI (`thermoslop`),
> an MCP server for AI clients, and status-bar output. Not affiliated with
> ecobee Inc. or Apple Inc.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://thermoslop.com/getting-started/): install, setup, discover, pair
- [MCP server](https://thermoslop.com/mcp/): tools, stdio and tailnet HTTP setup, guardrails
- [CLI reference: control](https://thermoslop.com/reference/control/): status, set, mode, comfort holds, log
- [CLI reference: pairing](https://thermoslop.com/reference/pairing/)
- [Concepts](https://thermoslop.com/concepts/): houses, the watcher, holds, the change log
- [Networking and discovery](https://thermoslop.com/networking/): when a thermostat isn't found or reachable
